7588.title: Wide coarse-pointer rail retains desktop sizing
7588.rootCauseOneLine: The rail touch-size override requires width below 48rem as well as a coarse pointer, excluding wide touch viewports.
7588.proposedFix: Decouple rail touch geometry from compact viewport width, with browser regression coverage of coarse and fine pointers across narrow and wide viewports.
7588.caveats: Repeated source-level parser evidence only; headless Chrome is unavailable, no screenshot or physical-device confirmation, and unchanged main has a Plugin SDK runtime build prerequisite failure. No production fix or PR.
